name: AerSale Corporation Common Stock
description: AerSale Corp offers full-service support to owners and operators of mid-life commercial aircraft. It specializes in the sale, lease, and exchange of used aircraft, engines, and components, in addition to providing various maintenance, repair, and overhaul, and engineering services for commercial aircraft and components. AerSale also offers asset management services to owners of end-of-life aircraft and engine portfolios. The company has two reportable segments: Asset Management Solutions and TechOps. Maximum revenue is generated from the Asset Management Solutions segment, which comprises activities to extract value from strategic asset acquisitions through leasing, trading, or disassembling for product sales. Geographically, the company derives maximum revenue from its domestic market.
